page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance type does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance. No graphics processing units are present on this hardware configuration.

With its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.hfr9i.2xlarge is classified as a memory-optimized instance. This resource density provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources without the overhead of paying for unneeded virtual cores. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. This configuration is suitable for memory-intensive workloads such as relational databases, in-memory caching systems, and enterprise applications.
